examples.purpose: A failed payment on the Pay screen, the guide's In context: a VStack column with the screen's Title and a negative Card Feedback (AppearanceSystem negative, because the payment failed; nothing else sets modes). Try again's onPress is a placeholder for the screen's own retry; when the retry goes through, the screen swaps the card for a positive one, since the card doesn't change itself or time out.
examples.jsx:
<VStack>
  <Title title="Pay Rahul Sharma" subtitle="₹1,250 from HDFC Bank" />
  <CardFeedback modes={{ AppearanceSystem: 'negative' }}>
    <CardFeedback.Icon icon="ic_error" />
    <CardFeedback.Content>
      <CardFeedback.Title>Payment failed</CardFeedback.Title>
      <CardFeedback.Body>Your bank declined the payment. No money was taken.</CardFeedback.Body>
      <CardFeedback.Action>
        <Button label="Try again" onPress={() => {}} />
      </CardFeedback.Action>
    </CardFeedback.Content>
  </CardFeedback>
</VStack>

from.quote: Try again runs the screen’s own retry through the button’s onPress.

examples.purpose: Two actions, the guide's States: Try again leads at its defaults and takes the status colour; Change bank is the quieter second action. Emphasis alone doesn't quieten a button in the status colour, so Change bank sets the guide's own modes, Semantic Intent Brand, AppearanceBrand Neutral and Emphasis Low, which render it transparent with dark text. The handlers are placeholders for the screen's own wiring.
examples.jsx:
<CardFeedback modes={{ AppearanceSystem: 'negative' }}>
  <CardFeedback.Icon icon="ic_error" />
  <CardFeedback.Content>
    <CardFeedback.Title>Payment failed</CardFeedback.Title>
    <CardFeedback.Body>Your bank declined the payment. No money was taken.</CardFeedback.Body>
    <CardFeedback.Action>
      <Button label="Try again" onPress={() => {}} />
      <Button
        label="Change bank"
        modes={{ 'Semantic Intent': 'Brand', AppearanceBrand: 'Neutral', Emphasis: 'Low' }}
        onPress={() => {}}
      />
    </CardFeedback.Action>
  </CardFeedback.Content>
</CardFeedback>

from.quote: Buttons take the status colour; a Button’s own modes make the second one quieter.

examples.purpose: A pressable card, the guide's States: onPress (a placeholder for the screen's own wiring) makes the whole card one button, so it has no buttons inside, and accessibilityLabel names it. Positive is the default status, so no modes are set.

    <CardFeedback.Body>₹1,250 was sent to Rahul Sharma.</CardFeedback.Body>

</CardFeedback>

props.name: children
props.description: The main content of the card (Icon, Title, Body, Action).

props.name: modes
props.description: Merged over the card's own modes, AppearanceSystem positive, Context Nudge&Alert and Semantic Intent System. Every part merges the card's modes with its own, and Icon, Content and Action give their children those modes under the child's own, so a child's own modes win. Declared: Modes object for token resolution.

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides for the card container.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Makes the root a Pressable with role button: hover opacity 0.92, pressed 0.8, a 1 px #0c0d10 ring on keyboard focus. Without onPress the root is a plain view. Declared: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable (rendered through a `Pressable` with `accessibilityRole="button"`).

props.name: disabled
props.description: With onPress: opacity 0.5, aria-disabled, tabindex -1 on the web, and presses are ignored. Declared: Disable interaction when `onPress` is set.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label forwarded to the pressable wrapper.

props.name: testID
props.description: Test identifier for the card root.

props.name: CardFeedback.Icon
props.description: icon, a registry name, drawn in a 20 px box in the status colour (appearanceFeedback/cardFeedback/icon/color); or children instead. The card doesn't pick an icon for a status. Declared: A static sub-component of CardFeedback. Its own props: children, style, modes, icon, testID.

props.name: CardFeedback.Content
props.description: A full-width column, gap 8, that holds Title, Body and Action. Declared: A static sub-component of CardFeedback. Its own props: children, style, modes, testID.

props.name: CardFeedback.Title
props.description: Text at 14/17, weight 500; it wraps. Declared: A static sub-component of CardFeedback. Its own props: children, style, modes, testID.

props.name: CardFeedback.Body
props.description: Text at 12/16, weight 400; it wraps. Declared: A static sub-component of CardFeedback. Its own props: children, style, modes, testID.

props.name: CardFeedback.Action
props.description: A wrapping row, gap 4; each child gets the card's modes under its own, so a Button's own modes win. Declared: A static sub-component of CardFeedback. Its own props: children, style, modes, testID.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: Changes only the title and body colour, a slight shift (Primary #0F0D0A / #1E1A14, Neutral #0D0D0F / #1A1C1F); the panel, the icon and the buttons keep the status colour. Declared: A token collection CardFeedback reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: AppearanceSystem
modes.description: The status (positive by default): panel and icon positive #DBF0D9 / #26AB21, warning #FFE3D6 / #F06E0F, negative #FFE0DE / #F50030. Buttons in Action take the same colour with a white label, at the small Nudge&Alert size (25 px). Declared: A token collection CardFeedback reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection CardFeedback reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: children
slots.description: The main content of the card (Icon, Title, Body, Action).

events.name: onPress
events.description: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable (rendered through a `Pressable` with `accessibilityRole="button"`).

gaps.text: The published Storybook hasn’t been rebuilt: it still renders every story as a pressable card with buttons inside it, and shows the older generated page.

Emphasis alone still changes nothing on a System button, such as a button in Action: button/background at Semantic Intent System branches only on AppearanceSystem. A token gap, noted on #286's re-test, not CardFeedback's.
